name: Research question finds its paper
purpose: The paper that answers a research question is among the observations an arm returns.
record: Cases passed over LitSearch questions, matched by exact title.
disadvantages: A title printed differently is missed, and a summary that names the paper is counted as found.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=claims checked against fixed fake sources] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]
command: esoi run know_the_world --impl openalex_semantic_and_web; esoi run know_the_world --impl openalex_semantic; esoi run know_the_world --impl web_research; esoi run know_the_world --impl openalex; esoi run know_the_world --impl openalex_keywords; esoi run know_the_world --impl openalex_keywords_model

name: Search finds the source
purpose: A top-five search hit comes from a page or site that holds the answer to a factual question.
record: Cases passed over SimpleQA questions against their named source pages.
disadvantages: A right site can still be the wrong page, and answers on sources the dataset does not list are missed.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=recorded responses go through each backend adapter] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > live [sample=sample | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=network access is allowed and the provider's terms permit the queries] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the live sample did not decide]
command: esoi run search_backend --impl gemini; esoi run search_backend --impl provider; esoi run search_backend --impl searxng; esoi run search_backend --impl brave; esoi run search_backend --impl serper; esoi run search_backend --impl tavily
